annotations.title: Google Veo 3 High-Definition Cinematic Video Generator

description: Synthesizes high-definition cinematic video sequences with temporally coherent camera motion and physics using Google Veo 3. Use when generating moving video clips, product B-roll, or animated scene renders from text prompts; for rendering static single-frame images or diagrams at lower cost, use generate_nano_banana_image instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('motion_style' defaults to 'static_tripod'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (1500 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

motion_style.description: Camera movement preset; defaults to 'smooth_tracking_shot' when omitted.

prompt.description: Cinematic scene description including subject motion, camera trajectory, and lighting.

name: generate_veo_cinematic_video

output.description: Generated video stream descriptor and frame metadata.
